wordmark.purpose: "Bigprint" in the top bar only; 22px under 900px.

figure.purpose: The final image size pinned at the bottom of the inspector; the unit in mute.

body.purpose: Upload card prompt and drag-over pill.

ui.purpose: Default text for controls, field names, sheet rows, assembly steps; buttons at 500.

measure.purpose: Margin input value, zoom percentage, inline sizes.

label.purpose: Sheet labels on the canvas; step numbers in mono.

ruler.purpose: Ruler numbers drawn on the canvas.

shadows.name: paper-lift-light
shadows.purpose: Paper sheets on the mat, light theme. The only shadow in the system.

shadows.name: paper-lift-dark
shadows.purpose: Paper sheets on the mat, dark theme.

shadows.name: cut-line
shadows.purpose: Two-tone line on inner edges of the assembled poster, readable over any photo.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Arrivals and feedback: fade-rise, value swaps, panel swap, theme reveal, drag-over.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Canvas moves (sheets, grid, rulers) and the sliding segmented pill.

motion.name: duration-feedback
motion.purpose: Ring and label colour (120ms linear), button colour (150ms), press scale 0.97 (160ms).

motion.name: duration-morph
motion.purpose: Layout change morph of sheets and grid; reassembly.

motion.name: duration-explode
motion.purpose: Pulling sheets apart in the print step.

motion.name: duration-arrival
motion.purpose: Sheets list rows rise 6px; photo wipes in row by row.

motion.name: duration-theme
motion.purpose: Circular theme reveal from the toggle via View Transitions.

motion.name: never-animates
motion.purpose: Pan and zoom while dragging or by keyboard, window resize, focus rings, mat scale between steps.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transitions collapse to colour or opacity fades; press scale, theme reveal and canvas moves are off.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action per screen: Continue to print, Print N sheets, Choose image.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--acc-fill, #bc4777); color: #fff; font: 500 13px/1.4 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--acc-deep, #a53c68); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid var(--acc, #e06a9d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined secondary action, e.g. Download PNGs.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18)); border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #e8efeb); font: 500 13px/1.4 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--panel-2, #131716); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid var(--acc, #e06a9d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Underlined quiet action: Replace image, Back to framing.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { height: 28px; padding: 0 4px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--mute, #8c9c95); font: 500 13px/1.4 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--line-strong, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18)); text-underline-offset: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-text:hover { color: var(--ink, #e8efeb); } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid var(--acc, #e06a9d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Measurement Input
components.description: Numeric field in mono with the unit inside the right edge.
components.css: .ds-measure { position: relative; display: block; width: 260px; } .ds-measure span { position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); font: 13px 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--mute, #8c9c95); pointer-events: none; } .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 40px 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18)); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--panel-2, #131716); color: var(--ink, #e8efeb); font: 13px/1.4 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; outline: none; appearance: textfield; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--acc, #e06a9d); outline: 1.5px solid var(--acc, #e06a9d); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Step Control
components.description: Upload · Frame · Print segmented control in the top bar; the active step is the magenta pill.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; height: 36px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.09)); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel-2, #131716); } .ds-seg-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: none; color: var(--mute, #8c9c95); font: 13px 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.175,1); } .ds-seg-item:hover { color: var(--ink, #e8efeb); } .ds-seg-item:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid var(--acc, #e06a9d); } .ds-n { font: 11px 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; width: 16px; text-align: center; } .ds-on { background: var(--sel-bg, #202826); color: var(--sel-fg, #e8efeb); } .ds-on.ds-acc { background: var(--acc-fill, #bc4777); color: #fff; }

components.name: Segmented Choice
components.description: Non-step choice (Size, Fill/Fit); selection uses the neutral selection colour, never magenta.
components.css: .ds-seg2 { display: flex; width: 260px; height: 36px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.09)); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel-2, #131716); } .ds-seg2-item { flex: 1; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: none; color: var(--mute, #8c9c95); font: 13px 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-seg2-item:hover { color: var(--ink, #e8efeb); } .ds-seg2-item:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid var(--acc, #e06a9d); } .ds-seg2-on { background: var(--sel-bg, #202826); color: var(--sel-fg, #e8efeb); }

components.name: Sheet Row
components.description: Sheets list row: tile thumbnail, name and position, and a position map; selected row in magenta wash.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 264px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: var(--ink, #e8efeb); text-align: left; font: 13px/1.4 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--panel-2, #131716); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid var(--acc, #e06a9d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-on, .ds-row-on:hover { background: var(--acc-soft, rgb(224 106 157 / 0.14)); } .ds-thumb { width: 32px; height: 45px; border-radius: 2px; outline: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18)); background: linear-gradient(#3a4a8a, #c86a88); } .ds-txt { flex: 1; } .ds-txt b { display: block; font-weight: 500; } .ds-row-on .ds-txt b { color: var(--acc, #e06a9d); } .ds-txt span { display: block; color: var(--mute, #8c9c95); } .ds-map { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 12px); gap: 2px; } .ds-map i { height: 14px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--line-strong, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18)); } .ds-map i.ds-cell-on { background: var(--acc-fill, #bc4777); }

components.name: Final Size Readout
components.description: The one large number: final image size in mono, pinned at the inspector's bottom.
components.html:
Final image
400 × 574 mm
4 sheets of A4 · 5 mm margin
components.css: .ds-final { width: 260px; padding: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.09)); background: var(--panel, #0a0c0c); color: var(--ink, #e8efeb); } .ds-cap { font: 13px/1.4 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--mute, #8c9c95); } .ds-fig { margin: 4px 0 6px; font: 26px/1.25 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: -0.02em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-fig span { color: var(--mute, #8c9c95); }

components.name: Cutting Mat
components.description: The canvas: mat with 10 mm and 50 mm grid lines and a paper sheet with the paper lift and a magenta selection ring.
components.css: .ds-mat { position: relative; width: 300px; height: 220px; background-color: var(--mat, #0d1e1b); background-image: linear-gradient(var(--grid-major, rgb(110 210 180 / 0.17)) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid-major, rgb(110 210 180 / 0.17)) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(var(--grid, rgb(110 210 180 / 0.075)) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid, rgb(110 210 180 / 0.075)) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 50px 50px, 50px 50px, 10px 10px, 10px 10px; } .ds-paper { position: absolute; left: 100px; top: 40px; width: 105px; height: 148px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 8px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); outline: 1.5px solid var(--acc, #e06a9d); } .ds-lbl { position: absolute; left: 100px; top: 20px; font: 11px 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--acc, #e06a9d); }

narrative.overview:
Bigprint is a canvas editor in the Figma/Framer family whose canvas is the self-healing mat the person will trim the sheets on. The mat carries a fine 10 mm grid with brighter 50 mm lines, millimetre rulers on the top and left edges mark exactly 0 to the poster's real width and height, and the sheets sit on it as white paper artboards at true scale. Everything around the mat is a quiet instrument: near-black (dark) or near-white (light) panels divided by 1px hairlines, Geist for words, Geist Mono for every number that is a measurement.

The system is dense and exact rather than airy. Panels are fixed-width columns with 20px gutters; type stays between 11px and 18px except for the wordmark and the final-size figure, which is the one large number on screen because the honest final size is the product's promise. Colour is almost entirely green-grey neutrals; one muted print-proof magenta marks what is active, selected or primary.

Both themes are first-class and carry the same structure. Dark is a green-black mat under near-black panels; light is a pale grey-green mat under near-white panels. The theme follows the system preference until the person toggles it, and the toggle reveals the new theme as a circle growing from the button.

The visual world rejects the empty gallery wall (an earlier, rejected direction) and the stock dark editor with a blue accent.
keyCharacteristics: A measured mat canvas: 10 mm minor grid, 50 mm major grid, mm rulers that end exactly at the poster's extent.
Paper is the only object with a shadow.
One muted magenta accent; every other surface is a green-tinted neutral.
Geist Mono for every millimetre, percentage and step number; tabular numerals everywhere.
Small radii (2px to 8px) and 1px hairlines; no decorative chrome.

rules.name: The One Proof Colour Rule
rules.body: Magenta marks only what is active, selected or primary: the current step, the selected sheet, the primary action, focus and the caret. Non-step selections (size, fit, orientation) use the neutral selection colour, never magenta.

rules.name: The Green Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral carries the mat's green tint (HSL hue 140 to 180). No pure greys in UI chrome, and no blue anywhere.

rules.name: The Mono Measurement Rule
rules.body: Every millimetre value, percentage and step number is Geist Mono. Words stay in Geist.

rules.name: The One Big Number Rule
rules.body: The final-size figure is the largest text in the app after the wordmark. No other value is set larger.

rules.name: The Only Paper Lifts Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to paper on the mat. Panels, cards, buttons and the upload card stay flat.

dos: **Do** set every measurement (mm, %, step numbers) in Geist Mono and keep tabular numerals on.
**Do** keep magenta for the current step, selected sheet, primary action, focus and caret; use the neutral selection colour for other choices.
**Do** draw new canvas elements in real millimetres at the shared pixels-per-mm scale, on the 10 mm / 50 mm grid.
**Do** keep the final size visible as one large mono figure with its unit in mute.
**Do** use the paper lift only for paper on the mat, and hairlines for everything else.
**Do** use `--ease-in-out` for canvas moves and `--ease-out` for arrivals, and give every animation a reduced-motion opacity fallback.
donts: **Don't** introduce a blue accent or a second accent colour.
**Don't** make the magenta brighter or more saturated (no neon); dark text-magenta is `#e06a9d` and fills stay at `#bc4777` or darker under white text.
**Don't** put shadows on panels, cards or controls.
**Don't** use radii above 8px on rectangles or round the paper sheets.
**Don't** let a label or control cover the image on the assembled poster.
